search_notes: Metadata screen (not a title/abstract reading): records excluded = not open access (310) plus non-primary publication types / review titles. Of the remaining open-access primary records, the top 200 by citation count (with quotas, search/selection_rule.md) were sought in full text; 99 retrieved; 99 form the corpus assessed for eligibility. Open-access primary records not in the top-ranked set were not sought (corpus-size decision by the review owner). Not retrieved (101): 47 no open-access PDF location known; 23 publisher OA URL returned a bot-check page instead of a PDF; 49 of the misses had a PMCID but PMC routes were blocked (Europe PMC ?pdf=render returned HTTP 403 (bot check); Europe PMC fullTextXML returned 500; NCBI PMC OA service returned 404 (2026-10-15)); 40 extension-batch misses not re-checked.
